newsitem.title: USA: Alkermes system means fewer hormone shots.
newsitem.headline: Alkermes system means fewer hormone shots.

text.p: Alkermes Inc said on Thursday in a U.S. Phase I clinical trial of its ProLease human growth hormone, a single ProLease injection resulted in sustained growth hormone levels in patients for several weeks.
ProLease hormone is a sustained release formulation of Genentech Inc's human growth hormone, based on Alkerme's ProLease injectable sustained release drug delivery system, the company said.

Based on the encouraging results, Alkermes and Genetech also said they signed an expanded collaboration agreement and started a multi-center Phase I/II clinical trial in children with growth hormone deficiency.
Alkermes said if development proceeded as planned, it would receiving funding for this phase of collaboration of over $20 million.

The ProLease growth hormone was designed to reduce the need for daily injections of human growth hormone by encapsulating the drug in biodegradable microspheres that slowly release human growth hormone over a period of weeks, the company said.

One injection yielded higher human growth hormone levels, a key growth promoting protein, insulin-like growth factor-I, and insulin-like growth factor-I's binding protein, for three to four weeks in adults with growth hormone deficiency, the company said.
